description: Interpretation sketch for 'Invers Kryssar med Velodrom' (NTHF, right wing, 7/10). No illustration or video exists; this is the AI's reading of the one-line description, laid out on the canonical rink, to be confirmed by the user before any trace or animation is made.
source_text: Pass from right wing to left wing, who passes along the boards behind the goal to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

related.invers-kryssar: Pass from right wing to left wing, who shoots into the left corner (no illustration)

reading: Kryssar = cross pass between the wingers; Invers = it goes from the right wing to the left wing (the base 'Invers Kryssar').

Velodrom = instead of shooting, the left wing sends the puck along the boards so that it rides the curved boards all the way round behind the goal, like a cyclist on a velodrome, and comes out along the right wing's board.
The right wing meanwhile moves up his slot and turns, and shoots the arriving puck first time ('directly') into the goal.

rw_start.note: W-RW low on its slot, turned toward the left wing, puck in front of the blade

lw_receive.note: W-LW at the +y board before the corner curve, blade angled toward the corner

rw_receive.note: W-RW moved 75 mm up its slot and turned round (back of the blade toward the goal, blade at the board)

wc_static.note: W-C (not part of the move) stands further back down its slot, out of the cross-pass lane

velodrome_launch.note: from the left wing's blade, along the +y board into the corner (speed chosen so the puck still arrives at about 0.7 m/s)
